name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US blockade; Iran vows 'all means' 23 Nov
summary: Iran vows all means against the US blockade on 23 Nov after attacks on Bahrain; tankers hit near Hormuz on 22 Nov
state: Iran's foreign ministry said on 23 Nov it would use all available means to counter the US naval blockade of its ports, which it calls military aggression (Al Jazeera). On 22 Nov Bahrain intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks, a fire broke out at an industrial site on Sitra Island, and UKMTO reported two tankers hit in the Strait of Hormuz (Gulf News). Trump said on 22 Nov that ships trying to break the blockade would be sunk, and has said strikes could resume after the new year without a deal (Euronews; Gulf News). Active state-on-state attacks keep the Alert.
for_you: Fuel, freight and insurance costs remain exposed to Gulf disruption. People in or travelling to Bahrain, the UAE, Qatar, Oman or Iran should follow FCDO travel advice; mariners should follow UKMTO guidance.
rubric_hit: Alert: active strikes between states (Iranian attacks on Bahrain 22 Nov) and attacks on shipping near Hormuz under a US blockade

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
